query:
The group operates on the understanding that when someone cannot make a plan, they give as much notice as possible. Does this hold for everyone in the group? If not, who behaves differently and what in the conversation shows it?

Options:
A. Jonah
B. Priya
C. Dev
D. Marcus
context:
[1] (about=Simone, episodic, t10 @2025-11-09T19:42:00) Three weeks. I told Priya the same day I signed but I wanted to get the notice sorted before I said anything here. It felt wrong to tell the group before I'd made it official.
[2] (about=Simone, episodic, t10 @2025-11-09T19:40:00) Actually, yes. There's something I've been putting off telling you all and I think Marcus already knows something is up, so I should just say it. I've accepted a secondment offer. Singapore. Twelve months, starting January. I handed my notice to the firm on Friday.
[3] (about=Marcus, episodic, t10 @2025-11-09T19:44:00) I messaged Simone separately last week because she'd gone quiet. She told me there was something big coming but didn't give me the details. I'm glad you've said it now. Singapore is genuinely a great opportunity and you've been building towards something like this for a while.
[4] (about=Marcus, episodic, t14 @2025-11-23T19:31:00) You're welcome to join us, Jonah. Dev and I are doing a twelve-kilometre trail route on the 30th. No Priya, obviously. She's been formally excused on medical grounds.
[5] (about=Jonah, episodic, t14 @2025-11-23T19:21:00) noted, Marcus has special rules for himself. classic. ok what about the 7th for Simone, that's a Sunday, she could be there, gives her two weeks before she flies
[6] (about=Priya, episodic, t14 @2025-11-23T19:35:00) there he is 😂 Marcus in full logistics mode is such a comfort honestly. I'm in if it doesn't clash with the thing
[7] (about=Jonah, episodic, t5 @2025-10-26T18:00:00) right so good news and bad news. good news: I sorted my invoice situation and money is real again. bad news: my client is asking for another cut of that commercial by Thursday and I'm going to be glued to premiere for three days straight
[8] (about=Marcus, episodic, t8 @2025-11-02T18:57:00) I mentioned this. The half-marathon training. Cutting alcohol for the duration. I told you all in October and nobody listened because Dev was doing something amusing with the bread rolls.
[9] (about=Jonah, episodic, t8 @2025-11-02T18:58:00) ok in fairness I did not absorb any of that. Marcus is doing a half marathon, that is actually news. when's the race
[10] (about=Jonah, episodic, t14 @2025-11-23T19:33:00) I'm in for the 30th. also Priya the 'city trip I'm planning' is very much your villain origin story for the next group argument. I respect it. tbf if it's a good city I'm not against it for the spring
[11] (about=Marcus, core, t14 @2025-11-23T19:16:00) Needs to make a New Year booking by Friday at the latest and asks everyone to confirm their plans.
[12] (about=Priya, episodic, t8 @2025-11-02T19:01:00) so the plan is Priya stands at the bottom in enormous waterproofs while Dev and Marcus sprint past her like it's a race 😑 amazing. Simone you're the only reasonable person coming on this trip
[13] (about=Simone, core, t10 @2025-11-09T19:31:00) Knew about the Singapore secondment for three weeks; told Priya the same day she signed but wanted to get the notice sorted before telling the group.
agent_answer:
No — it does not hold for everyone. Simone behaves differently.

The conversation shows it in [2]: Simone says she knew about the Singapore secondment for three weeks, told Priya the same day she signed, but wanted to get her notice sorted before telling the group. That means she delayed telling the group rather than giving them as much notice as possible.

(Simone is not among the listed options A–D.)
